description.value: Your flurry includes insightful remarks, snappy quips and baffling statements. You can replace one or both of your attacks during a Flurry of Blows to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.0GF2j54roPFIDmXf]{Bon Mot}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}; you must be an Expert in the associated skill to take those actions. For each of these actions you take, your multi-attack penalty still increases, but only after you complete your Flurry. An Attack will still increase your penalty as normal.

value.value: Expert in Diplomacy, Deception, or Intimidation
